title: A short proof of Mathar's 2016 recurrence conjecture for OEIS A176677
summary: For the OEIS sequence A176677, defined by the quadratic convolution recurrence $a(0) = a(1) = 1$ and $a(n+1) = \sum_{p=0}^n a(p) a(n-p) - 1$ for $n \ge 1$, R.~J.~Mathar contributed in March 2016 the conjectured order-4 P-recursive recurrence \[ (n+1)\,a(n) + 2(-3n+1)\,a(n-1) + (9n-13)\,a(n-2) - 4\,a(n-3) + 4(-n+4)\,a(n-4) = 0. \] We give a short proof. The convolution recurrence translates directly into the algebraic equation $z(1-z) G(z)^2 - (1-z) G(z) + (1 - z - z^2) = 0$ for the ordinary generating function $G(z)$, and Mathar's recurrence then drops out as the coefficient form of a…
